title: No access
summary: NoAccessPage for a forbidden deep link: Lucía, a Diceroll admin narrowed to Ship builds and Commerce, opens a link to Diceroll's licenses. The page names the area she lacks and her current role, lists the people who can give her access with copyable emails, and offers the places she can open.
compare: The sidebar is filtered by permission: Diceroll's context shows only the Ship builds and Commerce groups (open), with no Overview, Licensing, Managed config, Cloud Sync or Settings items. Nothing hidden is drawn disabled.

The title names the product and the area: 'You don't have access to Diceroll → Licensing', with 'Diceroll → Licensing' kept on one line; there is no breadcrumb, and the opened path is one small mono line under the cards.
The lead names the signed-in email and the current role as the same role tag Members uses (Diceroll admin · Ship builds, Commerce), and says what it doesn't include.

'Who can give you access' lists up to three people who can grant that area in that scope, narrowest first (the product's admins, then Superadmins), each with name, role and a copyable email. The card head is the heading alone. There is no Request access button and no request workflow (ST-33 is not built).

'You can open' offers the person's real destinations as buttons (Diceroll releases, Diceroll storefronts) and 'Open your library' as a link, so the page is never a dead end; 'Use another account' is a quiet link in the signed-in line.
The path that was opened shows as one small mono line; no data from the forbidden page appears, not even counts.
The same component answers a disabled control's reason elsewhere: a write button the member can't use names the same people in its disabledReason.
Phone: the menu button replaces the sidebar; the helpers stack (avatar and name, then the email chip under the name) and the two destination buttons take the full width.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Pass: the ask copy holds now that Product members has Add areas…; the title keeps 'Diceroll → Licensing' together on phone.

findings.issue: 'Ask one of them to add Licensing… They'll find you in Diceroll's members' promises an action Product members didn't offer for a rule-given role.
findings.resolution: Kept the copy: Diceroll → Settings → Members now gives Kenji 'Add areas…' on Lucía's rule-given row, and the list names only people who can do it (Kenji, then the two Superadmins).

findings.issue: On phone the title breaks as '…to Diceroll' / '→ Licensing'.
findings.resolution: 'Diceroll → Licensing' is wrapped in a no-wrap span, so the line breaks after 'to'. The footnote URL now wraps inside the column on phone, and the role tag uses the shared role-set markup (areas under the tag on phone).

findings.issue: The location was stated four times, the cards were staggered by 18px, and 'Use another account' sat in a different place on the two no-access screens.
findings.resolution: The breadcrumb and the sentence under the path are gone (title plus one small mono path remain); the cards stretch to equal height and the gap under 'You can open' is halved; 'Use another account' is a quiet link in the signed-in line on both screens.

findings.issue: Tables stretched to about 1615px at 1920, so cells sat 275px or more apart and the page widths differed across the area.
findings.resolution: Pages cap at one content width, centred: 1280px for tables, 1136px for forms and status pages (kit .page.cap-table, .page.cap-form).

findings.issue: Small muted mono keys, dates and helper text carried facts at subtle colour and under 12px; disabled buttons were near invisible; row-menu targets were 28px.
findings.resolution: Fact-bearing small text moves to the muted token and 12px or more; the light subtle token is #4f586d (4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes); disabled buttons keep a visible border at 0.6 opacity (0.8 on primary); the row-menu trigger is 32px with a 44px hit area (44px on phone); colour-only Adds and Joins carry a glyph.

findings.issue: Make the copy-address chip a mailto link, label the first admin 'Ask first', and show the URL only in dev builds.
findings.resolution: declined: mailto links are unreliable, and the rest is new behaviour. Trimming the footer is enough.

findings.issue: h1 plus tabs is the kit's pattern; role names and the glossary are owner and consolidation-plan decisions.
findings.resolution: declined: Change the h1 to match each tab, add breadcrumbs on platform pages, or add 'Rename Console access to Viewer' and a glossary entry.
